note: Shared A2UI catalog contract. Python reads this file to build the agent prompt and to validate generated components; frontend/src/a2ui-catalog.tsx registers the matching React implementations. The catalogId must be byte-identical on both sides — the renderer matches catalogs by exact string equality.

layoutComponents.Column: Vertical stack. Props: children (array of component ids), gap.
layoutComponents.Row: Horizontal row. Props: children (array of component ids), gap.
layoutComponents.Card: Bordered container around one child. Props: child (component id).
layoutComponents.Text: A line or paragraph of text. Props: text, variant (one of: display, headline, title, body, caption).
layoutComponents.Button: A clickable button. Props: text, onClick.

ReleaseSummary.description: Headline readiness verdict for the release. Use this once, near the top, when the user asks about readiness.

statusLabel.description: Short verdict, e.g. 'Not ready for production'.

ready.description: True only when there are no blockers.

passingChecks.description: Names of the checks that passed.

BlockerList.description: The list of things blocking release. Bind to /blockers.

blockers.description: Array of objects with 'title' and 'detail'. Bind to /blockers.

MigrationRiskCard.description: The pending database migration: its risk, what it does, and how to mitigate it.

ApprovalForm.description: Complete, self-contained security-approval form. It owns its own reviewer picker, comment field, required-field validation and submit button, and it reports its own status. Never build a form out of Text and input components; use this. Do not add your own submit button next to it.
